title: A Busy Week for Maya
text:
Maya is fifteen years old and she lives in a small town. She goes to school in the morning and plays volleyball after class. On weekends, she likes to meet her friends at the café near her house.

Last month, Maya started a new hobby. She joined a music club because she wants to learn the guitar. Her parents were surprised, but they are happy that she is trying new things.

questions.text: What instrument does Maya want to learn?
What can you infer about Maya from the first paragraph?
options: She is an active and social teenager
She lives in a big city
She prefers to stay alone at home
Maya joined a new club, which was unexpected

vocabulary.definition: a team sport played by hitting a ball over a net
an activity you do for fun in your free time

paragraph_translations: Maya on beş yaşında ve küçük bir kasabada yaşıyor. Sabahları okula gidiyor ve dersten sonra voleybol oynuyor. Hafta sonları evinin yakınındaki kafede arkadaşlarıyla buluşmayı seviyor.
Geçen ay Maya yeni bir hobi edindi. Gitar çalmayı öğrenmek istediği için bir müzik kulübüne katıldı. Ailesi şaşırdı, ama yeni şeyler denemesine sevindiler.
